findings.body:
chunk 1/3:

Gain 4, Work 1, Harm 2
Raise: Functional
Case: normal use - the pull request runs Starter smoke.
The new archive command requires the historical commit locally, but `.github/workflows/starter-smoke.yml:40` uses `actions/checkout@v4` without configuring history. Its [default fetch-depth is 1](https://github.com/actions/checkout/blob/v4/action.yml), so that commit is unavailable on a fresh runner. The pytest command at workflow line 48 includes both affected earlier-adopted tests, which now fail during setup with `CalledProcessError` before their assertions run. Fetch the pinned commit or configure sufficient checkout history so the existing CI cases can pass.

findings.body:
chunk 3/3:

Gain 4, Work 1, Harm 2
Raise: Functional
Case: normal use - the pull request runs Starter smoke CI.
This archive requires historical Git objects, but `.github/workflows/starter-smoke.yml:40` uses `actions/checkout@v4` without overriding its [default fetch depth of 1](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/actions/checkout/v4/action.yml). That job runs the feature-command tests at line 48, including the earlier-adopted cases. The pinned commit is therefore unavailable on the fresh runner, and `git archive` fails before those cases reach their assertions. Fetch the pinned commit or configure this job to fetch full history.
